# Context menu

A menu of actions on right-click or long-press.

<p class="odv-compstatus"><span class="odv-pill">In Dense data</span></p>

## See it live

<div class="odv-live"><span class="odv-wait">Start Storybook to see it live: <code>npm run storybook</code></span><iframe src="http://localhost:6006/iframe.html?id=components-context-menu--examples&viewMode=story&globals=scheme:dense-data;mode:light" title="Context menu examples in Storybook" loading="lazy"></iframe><div class="bar"><span>Live from Storybook</span><a href="http://localhost:6006/?path=/docs/components-context-menu--docs">Open Context menu in Storybook</a><a href="http://localhost:6006/iframe.html?id=components-context-menu--examples&viewMode=story&globals=scheme:dense-data;mode:dark">See it in dark</a></div></div>

## When to use it

**In Dense data:** Right-click on a row, for experts.

- **Use it when:** Power users acting on an item in place, with the same actions also reachable elsewhere.
- **Not when:** The only way to reach an action: people who don't know to right-click never find it.

Instead:

- [Dropdown menu](./dropdown-menu.md): The same actions from a visible button.

## Words

- Lead with the object, then the state: "Alert 2041 contained."
- Use numbers, not words for numbers.
- One verb per button. No "please", no exclamation marks.
- Use: Investigate, Filter, Assign, Escalated, Resolved. Avoid: Oops, Awesome, Please, Simply.

The labels components use, from the voice tokens:

- `content.action.commit`: Save
- `content.action.cancel`: Cancel
- `content.action.destroy`: Delete
- `content.action.retry`: Retry
- `content.action.empty-action`: Change filters

See [Voice and tone](../voice.md) for the whole voice.

## Accessibility and keyboard

| Keyboard | What happens | Not |
| --- | --- | --- |
| undefined | Shift F10 or the menu key opens it; arrows move; Escape closes. | undefined |



## Use it in code

```bash
npx open-ds add context-menu
```

The component reads only component keys and semantic tokens, so it follows the brand and mode on `<html>`.

## Tokens it reads

Context menu reads 11 of Dense data's tokens. Each row follows one part of the component from its class to the value it ends at, in every theme. Change a token in the scheme and every component that reads it follows.
